test_cases.question: How do I troubleshoot VPN error 809?
test_cases.answer: VPN error 809 is always caused by an expired password [1].

evidence.text: VPN error 809 can occur when a network connection or firewall blocks the VPN connection. Check network connectivity and firewall settings.

test_cases.question: How do I request Azure access?
test_cases.answer: All employees automatically receive administrator access without approval [1].

evidence.text: Employees must submit an access request and obtain the required approval before receiving access to Azure resources.

test_cases.question: How do I troubleshoot VPN error 809?
test_cases.answer: Check network connectivity and firewall settings [1]. You must also reinstall Windows because error 809 always damages the operating system [1].

evidence.text: VPN error 809 can occur when a network connection or firewall blocks the VPN connection. Check network connectivity and firewall settings.
